business_summary: China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in new energy power generation in the Chinese Mainland, Canada, South Africa, and Ukraine. China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Limited was formerly known as China Longyuan Electric Power Group Corporation and changed its name to China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Limited in July 2009. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Beijing, China. China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Limited is a subsidiary of Chnenergy Investment Group Co.,LTD.
business_summary_ko: China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국 본토, 캐나다, 남아프리카 및 우크라이나에서 신에너지 발전에 참여하고 있습니다. China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Limited는 이전에 China Longyuan Electric Power Group Corporation으로 알려졌으며 2009년 7월에 China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다. China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Limited는 Chnenergy Investment Group Co.,LTD의 자회사입니다.
